subject: function:AudioUnloadPart
value: Raw Xbox PDB evidence distinguishes int AudioFindPart(char* pname) from int AudioFindBank(struct s_audpart* part, char* bname). The retained GameCube one-argument helper named AudioFindBank scans the current mode's 292-byte descriptors; its data-access shape corresponds to Xbox s_audmode.parts/s_audpart and makes AudioFindPart the better candidate attribution. The source copy's layout is verifiable against GC instructions; identity with the exact Xbox helper definition and its source body is still unproven. This corrects the name-based inference used to motivate R74, not the verified correctness or raw exactness of its retained source. No source/header/configuration changes or compiler probes were performed in this read-only evidence pass.
